info.name: BuildHub API
info.description:
Every BuildHub endpoint, in an order that is safe to run top to bottom.

Folders 01-09 create their own data and exercise CRUD plus the documented rules. Folder 10 proves the delete guards refuse - nothing is removed there. Folder 11 removes everything this run created, strictly leaf first, so no row is ever cascade-deleted and no request reads something an earlier delete took away. The seeded sample data is only ever read, never modified.

Set baseUrl if your app is not on http://localhost:5158.

item.name: Category in use cannot be deleted
Vendor with offers and reviews cannot be deleted
Job whose offer became an agreement cannot be deleted
User with jobs and reviews cannot be deleted
Delete review (before its agreement, so no cascade)
Delete product (frees the vendor and the category)
Delete agreement (its review is already gone)
Delete offer A (its agreement is already gone)
Delete job (its offers are already gone)
Delete vendor user A (profile already gone)
Delete homeowner (jobs, review and notification already gone)
